source.citation: Classified advertisement, the rental agent 'Brinkman, 2105 Indiana-av.'. Chicago Sunday Tribune, 31 January 1904 (vol. 63 no. 5).
what_it_does_not_supply: the building's form, storeys, material or outline
what_it_supplies: that 2105 Indiana Avenue was occupied, as an agent's office address, from January 1904 to 1908
